data.gender_notes: Jawayriyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'jawar', meaning 'soft, gentle, delicate'. This name is often used for girls, symbolizing grace and kindness. The name Jawayriyah carries the meaning “Gentle, Delicate, Soft” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Jawayriyah usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle, delicate, soft and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies softness and gentleness, reflecting the compassionate and nurturing aspects of Allah.
data.etymology: Jawayriyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle, Delicate, Soft.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jawayriyah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
